candidate.answerReason: The centered picture leaves two equal gaps totaling 19 - 3 = 16 feet, so each gap is 8 feet.

methods.label: Share the remaining width equally
methods.explanation:
Because the picture is centered, the empty spaces on its left and right have equal widths. Together these spaces measure
\[
19-3=16\text{ feet}.
\]
Each space is half of that total:
\[
16\div2=8\text{ feet}.
\]
The nearest edge of the picture is \(8\) feet from either end of the wall, choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
methods.levelReason: The centered placement gives equal lengths, followed by elementary subtraction and equal sharing.
